name: por-output-chain-ibias-sharing
description: Post-layout re-run of the schematic-level record in sim/por-output-chain-ibias-sharing/records/ (issue #221) -- same claim, against layout/postlayout/{bias_core,temp_core,por_comparator,por_output_chain}.spice instead of the design/netlist/ exports.
claim: design/por_output_chain.md#hand-off-to-11-the-ibias-envelope-is-the-real-constraint (IBIAS must not fall below ~0.44x nominal at por_output_chain's own pin) and spec/decision-records/DR-010-shared-ibias-disabled-consumer-contract.md's high-impedance-when-disabled contract. Deterministic corners only (design.ngspice sets sw_stat_mismatch=0); mismatch on the mirror ratios is #15's job. This record makes no por-brownout pass/fail claim of its own -- sim/por-output-chain-deglitch/ is re-cut against the current this record measures, per issue #221.
netlist_provenance_note: Four-way splice (per sim/build_tb.py's FRAGMENTS -- bias_core + temp_core + por_comparator + por_output_chain), each leg's caveat from its own layout/postlayout/<cell>.spice header (layout/postlayout/AUDIT.md): bias_core -- 7 body/plate ties (NW1, NWQ, XCC__NZ, XCC__PG, XCOK__NOKX, XCOK__VDD, vsubs) to the schematic's net; no ideal device, all 70 drawn. por_comparator -- 3 body/plate ties (NW1, NW2, vsubs); no ideal device, all 21 drawn. por_output_chain -- 12 body/plate/well ties (NW1->VDD, XCDG/XCTIM plate+VSS ties, vsubs->VSS); no ideal device, all 33 drawn. temp_core -- 4 body/plate ties (NW1, NW2, NWQ, vsubs); XCC (cap_mim_2f0_m3m4_noshield, on PG/NZ) is IDEAL -- not drawn in this cell's layout, reserved floor area -- the one golden device this design still does not draw. Any check whose behavior depends on XCC is therefore a schematic claim for the temp_core leg even though the netlist as a whole is extracted; none of this testbench's checks do (temp_core's XCC sits inside its own PTAT/CTAT generation loop, not on the IBIAS path this record meters).

ibias_por_asserted_na.description: por_output_chain's own IBIAS pin current, RESETn asserted. design/por_output_chain.md's stated floor for its deglitch dwell ceiling to hold: IBIAS must not fall below ~0.44x nominal (500 nA nominal -> 220 nA) at the SS/-40C corner. THIS IS THE CORRECTNESS REQUIREMENT, NOT AN ASSERTED OBSERVATION -- it may fail before a lever from issue #221 lands.

ibias_por_released_na.description: Same floor, RESETn released -- temp_core's own mirror diode has rejoined the shared node here, so this branch is expected to be the tighter of the two per design/bias_core.md's 'The shared IBIAS net' (the node steps down at release).

por_raw_asserted_droop_mv.description: Regression guard on sim/bias-core-ibias-sharing/'s own liveness claim (DR-010): with the rail above every corner's release threshold, POR_RAW must still go high with por_output_chain also present on the shared node.

vibias_asserted_v.description: Shared node sits at a real diode drop, not clamped near VSS -- the DR-010 high-impedance contract holding with por_output_chain's own always-on XMBD also on the node.
